sloka: एष मे राम शोकान्तः शोक आर्तेन निवेदितः ।दुःखितः सुखितः वा अपि सख्युः नित्यम् सखा गतिः ॥४-८-४०॥
transliteration: eṣa me rāma śokāntaḥ śoka ārtena niveditaḥ ।duḥkhitaḥ sukhitaḥ vā api sakhyuḥ nityam sakhā gatiḥ ॥4-8-40॥

translations.english: 'This what I had to tell you out of sorrow. This is how my sorrow will end. In joy and in sorrow your friend is your refuge.
